Made up for testing: a small collection of fossils and subfossils, with no DNA.

- `specimens.csv`: two subfossil bones from a cave layer, and two Cretaceous fossils from a chalk
  cliff with the formation, member and stage as the collection records them (the names are
  invented).
- `dates.csv`: two radiocarbon dates of the cave layer (its field number). One is of the bone FOS-1
  itself, the other of charcoal from the same layer that isn't in the collection.
- `rocks.csv`: a rock sample from the cliff with its lithology and minerals, analysed by X-ray
  diffraction.
